_VisuAuth: Microsoft Entra External ID adapter config. Required: TenantId, ClientId, ClientSecret, TenantDomain (the initial {tenant}.onmicrosoft.com host). Optional: AppRoleResourceId (defaults to ClientId), GraphBaseUrl (defaults to public cloud v1.0), DefaultEmailDomain. Populate via `dotnet user-secrets set VisuAuth:EntraExternal:TenantId ...` (and friends) — NEVER commit real values. See Program.cs for setup steps.
